name: admin_persona
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk persona — a named assistant profile (prompt and assigned skills) that determines how an AI agent behaves and which skills it can use.

attributes.name: prompt_md
attributes.description: System prompt for the persona, in Markdown.

attributes.name: avatar_url
attributes.description: URL of the persona's avatar image.

attributes.name: skill_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the skills assigned to this persona. Each must reference an existing, active skill.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the persona is active. Defaults to active when omitted.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the persona was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the persona was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
